titulo: NASA’s Curiosity Captures Dawn Breaking on Wind-Carved Cliffs
cuerpo: Description NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover captured this panorama of sunrise illuminating distant, wind-carved features called yardangs on Aug. 11, 2026, the 4,982nd Martian day, or sol, of the mission.
